entries.168ad06b81a82ccb: A materials manufacturer that makes and sells functional materials such as copper foil and exhaust gas purification catalysts, and metals such as zinc, lead, gold and silver.
entries.447d20ad0142e4c5: This business makes materials used for electronic components and for exhaust gas control in automobiles. It manufactures and sells copper foil (carrier-attached ultra-thin copper foil, electrolytic copper foil for printed wiring boards, etc.), exhaust gas purification catalysts, metal powders for electronic materials, battery materials such as hydrogen-storage alloys, rare materials such as high-purity tantalum oxide, ceramic products, and sputtering targets such as ITO. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥319,553 million, the largest of the four reportable segments. The company states that sales volumes increased for copper foil for semiconductor package substrates and AI servers, and for exhaust gas purification catalysts for motorcycles.
entries.57e5087d450db30b: This business manufactures and sells automotive door locks. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,218 million. Because the company transferred all shares of Mitsui Kinzoku Act Corporation, which carries out this business, and its subsidiaries in November 2025, the fiscal year ended March 2026 records results for only the six months from April to September 2025.
entries.5e31f8b8e608c0d9: Functional powders (metal powders for electronic materials)
entries.76e71a0154d99dab: Rare materials (high-purity tantalum oxide, protective film materials for semiconductor equipment)
entries.89aae7026a0e99a6: Copper foil (carrier-attached ultra-thin copper foil, electrolytic copper foil for printed wiring boards)
entries.959b668531d49c02: This business produces and sells zinc, lead, copper, gold and silver, and also carries out resource recycling. It outsources smelting to smelting companies such as Kamioka Kōgyo, Hachinohe Seiren, Hikoshima Seiren and Hibi Kyōdō Seiren. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥290,230 million. The company states that revenue increased due to rising market prices for non-ferrous metals such as zinc.
entries.da65e9e926d16cf5: This business engages in engineering for various industrial plants and the manufacture and sale of wrought copper products, perlite products, die-cast products and powder metallurgy products, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥98,595 million. The company states that orders for large-scale construction projects from group companies and for overseas customers were solid.
